summary: Phase A (Recruitment Core) end-to-end verified. Backend pytest 10/10 pass on /app/backend/tests/test_careers_phase_a.py. Curl meta check confirms 30 statuses / 10 sources / 6 hiring_types / 4 work_modes / 5 employment_types / 6 experience_ranges / 7 qualifications.
